evals.prompt: There is an invoice at /workspace/input/invoice.pdf. Extract the invoice number, the total due (amount and currency) and the bill-to company, and write them as JSON with keys invoice_number, total_due, currency, bill_to to /workspace/output/invoice.json.
assertions: The agent read the PDF text rather than guessing
invoice.json has the four requested keys with correct values

evals.prompt: Merge /workspace/input/report-a.pdf followed by /workspace/input/report-b.pdf into a single PDF at /workspace/output/merged.pdf, preserving page order.
evals.expected_output: /workspace/output/merged.pdf is a valid 3-page PDF: report A pages 1-2, then report B page 1.
assertions: merged.pdf exists and is a valid PDF
Page order is A1, A2, B1

evals.prompt: Create a one-page PDF at /workspace/output/memo.pdf whose text contains the title 'Release memo' and the sentence 'Version 2.4 ships on 14 November.'
evals.expected_output: /workspace/output/memo.pdf is a valid 1-page PDF whose extractable text contains both strings.
assertions: memo.pdf exists, is a valid PDF and has exactly one page
Extracted text contains the title and the sentence

evals.prompt: What is 17 multiplied by 23? Reply with just the number.
assertions: The agent did not run PDF tooling for an unrelated request
